site.tagline: Learn to type by copying real stories.

home.title: Lectype — learn to type by copying real books
home.headline: Learn to type by copying real books.
home.intro: Carroll, Kipling, Poe, Perrault… Pick a work, type it page after page with an on-screen keyboard that matches yours, and watch your speed grow.
home.free: Free, no ads. Without an account, your progress stays in your browser.
home.step1: Public domain novels, tales, fables, short stories and poems, in French and English.
home.step2: The on-screen keyboard lights up the next key and the finger to use. A mistake doesn't move you forward.
home.step3: A summary after each chapter: speed, accuracy and the keys that trip you up.
home.learnText: From the home row to accents and numbers. Lessons follow your keyboard layout, and exercises use real words from the books.
home.storiesText: In “Oscar et la capsule silencieuse”, type one of the sentences offered to decide what happens next.
home.macTitle: Lectype is also on the Mac.
home.macText: The same books, a keyboard that follows your exact layout, and typewriter sounds. macOS 26 or later.

privacy: You can use Lectype without an account. Your progress, statistics and settings then stay in your browser (local storage) and are never sent to us.

We store your first name, your email address, a hash of your password (bcrypt: the password itself is never stored), your progress (books, stories, lessons), your typing sessions, the list of your logged-in devices (browser and system) and a security log (logins, password changes, with the IP address). This data is only used to run and protect your account.
Confirmation and security emails are sent by our provider Brevo. We never send you advertising.
Lectype only uses two necessary cookies: a session cookie (to stay logged in and protect forms) and a language cookie. No advertising or analytics cookies.

Your data is kept as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, it is erased immediately, security log included. Sessions expire on their own, after 30 days at most. Security log entries (including failed login attempts) are erased after 6 months.

From “My account”, you can edit your information, export all your data (JSON) and delete your account. For any question, write to the address given in the legal notice. You can also lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority, at dataprotectionauthority.be.
The site and its data are hosted in France by the host named in the legal notice.

download.title: Lectype for Mac
download.intro: The Lectype Mac app: the same books and stories, a keyboard that follows your Mac's exact layout, and typewriter sounds.
download.requirements: macOS 26 or later · Mac with Apple silicon or Intel · free
steps: Open the Lectype.dmg file you just downloaded.
Drag the Lectype icon onto the Applications folder.
Open Lectype from the Applications folder. macOS says it could not verify the app: click “Done”.
Open System Settings › Privacy & Security, scroll down to Lectype, click “Open Anyway” and confirm. From then on, Lectype opens normally.
download.why: Lectype is not yet verified by Apple (“notarization” requires a paid membership), so macOS asks for your confirmation once. The app sends no data and works offline.
download.other: The web version works in any browser, on Windows, Linux or a tablet.
